info.title: Dishari API
info.description: Dishari - bilingual SSC Physics MCQ concept & cognitive-level tagging API. All errors use {"error": {"code", "message", "fields"}}. Auth: Bearer JWT from /v1/auth/login.

post.description:
Self sign-up. Students and parents can log in at once (a parent can link a child with the link code).
A TEACHER account is created as `pending` and can log in only after an admin approves it
(`POST /users/{id}/approve`); the response is then `{pending: true, message}` instead of tokens.

schema.title: Response Register V1 Auth Register Post

post.description: Revokes every token of this user (all devices).
Profile photo (PNG/JPG/WEBP, max 3 MB). Cropped to a square, 400 px.
New parent-link code (the old one stops working; already linked parents stay linked).

get.description: Numbers for the profile page, per role.

post.description:
Always 202 (does not reveal whether the email exists). Email sending is a deployment task
(Sumaiya); in DEBUG the reset token is returned so the frontend flow can be tested.

get.description: The whole tree in one call (13 chapters / 91 concepts / 193 topics) - cache it on the frontend.

schema.title: Response Chapters V1 Taxonomy Chapters Get

get.description: Public: K1-K4 definitions (used on the landing/help page too).

schema.title: Response Levels V1 Taxonomy Levels Get

patch.description: Admin can rename EN/BN names. IDs never change (the ML model depends on them).

post.description:
Main entry: send 1..500 MCQs, get tags back. save=false -> preview only (nothing stored).
A row with invalid input returns ok=false with an error code; other rows still succeed.

schema.title: Response Tag Questions V1 Questions Tag Post

get.description: The question bank (with the same filters as the list) as an Excel file with tags.

patch.description:
Edit text and/or tags. Text change -> re-tag by model. Manual tag change by a teacher -> needs_review;
by a moderator/admin -> verified.

get.description: All model predictions + all moderator reviews for one question (audit trail on the detail page).

post.description:
Tag review: accept the current tags of the chosen questions. A moderator/admin marks them `verified`;
a teacher confirms their own questions (status `tagged`, tag source `teacher`) and a moderator can still check them.
Attach a figure (PNG/JPG/WEBP, max 3 MB). Replaces the old one. Shows as image_url.

Photo (JPG/PNG/WEBP) or PDF of a question paper -> draft MCQs (Bangla and English).
Nothing is saved: the teacher checks/edits the draft, then sends it to POST /questions/tag.
Starts a background job. Poll GET /bulk/jobs/{id} every 1-2 s until status is done/failed.

get.description: Live check while a teacher types a question.
Needs-review questions, lowest confidence first, plus questions with open tag reports.
Balance of the paper vs its K1-K4 target (W06 analysis panel).

post.description: Upload an existing question paper (Excel/CSV); get its K1-K4 balance. Nothing is saved.

get.description:
xlsx = data sheet + analysis; docx = printable Word paper (+ answer key page);
html = print-ready page -> browser 'Save as PDF' (best Bangla rendering).

get.description: Printable OMR answer sheet that matches this paper (number of questions, header).

post.description: Upload 1–60 photos/scans of filled OMR sheets. Each is read, graded with its set's key and matched to a student by roll.

patch.description: Teacher corrects what the reader saw (set, roll, a bubble, or the student).

post.description: Picks random tagged/verified questions (with an answer key) for the chosen chapters/levels.

get.description: W09 progress chart: score per session over time + accuracy per level and chapter.
(R2) Concept mastery using (Σw·correct+1)/(Σw+2); Easy 1, Medium 1.5, Hard 2.

post.description: Link a child with the code shown on the child's profile page.

delete.description: Remove a linked child from this parent account (the child's account is not touched).

get.description:
Saturday-to-Friday report: activity, accuracy vs last week, levels, chapters, weak concepts, suggestions.
offset=1 is last week. format=html gives a printable page.
Staff: tests they created (with attempt counts). Student: tests open to their class, with their state.

schema.title: Response Pending Teachers V1 Admin Pending Teachers Get

post.description: Admin starts a password reset for a user (same link as 'forgot password').

put.description:
Thresholds, upload limits and security. Keys: board_match_threshold, review_threshold, max_upload_rows,
max_upload_mb, access_token_minutes, refresh_token_days, lock_after_failed, login_rate_limit.

get.description: Students a teacher can add to a group (name / email / roll search, optional class + section).
What a teacher can make a class report for: their online tests, their papers with OMR sheets, their groups.

Average, students, students who need attention (< 50 %), weakest topics, score by level.
Pick one of test_id / paper_id (its OMR sheets + its online tests) / group_id; none = all of my classes.
`format=html` gives a printable page (browser → Save as PDF).
Everything the student (and a linked parent) home screen needs in one call.
Frontend shows a banner if status != ready (questions will stay 'pending').

post.description:
Raw passthrough to the model using the ML contract (for Razzaque to test the deployed model).
Nothing is saved.

get.description:
Model vs moderator agreement (per field, K1-K4 confusion matrix, precision/recall/F1, by confidence,
by model version). format=xlsx for the capstone report.
Model versions (read-only, for the AI model page).

post.description: Register a model version and (optionally) hot-load it without restarting the server.
After the real model is deployed, tag every question that was saved while the model was down.
